tasks.label: BuildMLflowStartPrometheus
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host '=== Starting Prometheus ==='; docker compose up -d prometheus; $exit1 = $LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "prometheus exit: $exit1"; Write-Host '=== Building MLflow image (pip install) ==='; docker compose build mlflow; $exit2 = $LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "mlflow build exit: $exit2"; Write-Host '=== Done ==='

tasks.label: BuildMLflow2
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; docker compose build mlflow 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath 'C:\Temp\mlflow_build.txt' -Append; Write-Host "EXIT: $LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content 'C:\Temp\mlflow_build.txt' | Select-Object -Last 10

tasks.label: RebuildBackendStartApi
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; Write-Host '=== Rebuilding xauusd-backend with infra packages ==='; docker compose build api 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath 'outputs\build_backend.log' -Append; $e=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "Build exit: $e"; if ($e -eq 0) { Write-Host '=== Starting api service ==='; docker compose up -d api; } else { Write-Host 'BUILD FAILED - check outputs\build_backend.log' }

tasks.label: BuildApi
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:\Users\Administrator\Documents\Trade-Indicator'; $env:DOCKER_BUILDKIT='1'; Write-Host '=== Building xauusd-api (from local xauusd-backend:latest) ==='; docker build -f Dockerfile.api -t xauusd-api:latest . 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath 'outputs\build_api.log' -Append; $e=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Host "Build exit: $e"; if ($e -eq 0) { Write-Host 'SUCCESS - starting api...'; docker compose up -d api; Write-Host 'API started!'; docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}`t{{.Status}}`t{{.Ports}}' } else { Write-Host 'FAILED'; Get-Content 'outputs\build_api.log' | Select-Object -Last 20 }

tasks.label: ApiImageBuild2026
